## Getting there

## Attendance and registration

- Full attendance is mandatory.
- Registration: {{< edition hs2026 registration >}}. This site takes no registrations.
- A late withdrawal after the registration deadline, or an unannounced absence, incurs a fee of {{< edition hs2026 no_show_fee >}} under the published course regulations.
- Further consequences for later registrations follow the {{< edition hs2026 regulations_url link="regulations of the Transferable Skills programme" >}}. This site does not repeat them.

Write to {{< edition hs2026 contact link="the course administration" >}} about registration, attendance, or a withdrawal. Do not use GitHub for these questions.

## Prepare for the course day

1. Read the required text: Bender et al., [On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots](https://doi.org/10.1145/3442188.3445922) [-@bender2021].
2. Choose two recommended readings or cases from the [literature](../literature.qmd) page.
3. Write a short description of one actual or planned use of generative AI in your research. Say why you might use it and what you do not know about it.
4. Bring a laptop.

The [assignments](../assignments.qmd) page gives a proposed plan for the eight hours of preparation.

::: {.callout-important title="Protect your data"}
Do not bring confidential or personal research data to the exercises. No exercise needs a commercial AI account.
:::
